description: Milestone 3 (README Part III), chosen configuration (better than the max kernel with and without the mask, output_m3/): LidarFit for ITODD obj 12 (cylinder) with the twinchers of the tent probe kernel (charts A and B, noise-trained), without the amodal mask (depth and mask_visib only); solver settings as for the connector (fill_visib, fill_target, clamp 1). Paths are relative to this file.

decisions.parameters: p0 -> distance D of the camera from the model origin (BOP depth_range of ITODD test images, mm); p1 -> elevation of the camera above the model XY plane (90 deg - polar angle); p2 -> roll about the optical axis (0: model +Z up in the image, positive counterclockwise); linear maps from [-1, 1]; azimuth fixed (continuous symmetry about Z); |roll| < 90 deg suffices because of the flip symmetry; chart margins 0.3 rad.
decisions.rendered image: square of normalized image coordinates centred on the optical axis, half-side = margin * r / sqrt(D_min^2 - r^2) (r: radius of the bounding sphere about the model origin, 53.85 mm), i.e. 0.0931 (+-5.3 deg, 557 ITODD camera pixels); resolution 512^2 (1.09 camera pixels per pixel); Z depth along the optical axis, 0 where a ray misses; ray casting with NVIDIA Warp on the model mesh (models/, 348 faces).
decisions.probes: 16 x 16 probes on a grid centred at the centre of mass of the silhouette (z > 0), ordered from the centre outward; kernel 'tent': the mean height above the background weighted with (1 - |dx|/K)(1 - |dy|/K), K = probe spacing = 32 pixels (weights sum to one over the grid); y in [-0.8, 0.8] for depths D_min - r .. D_max + r, background 0.8. The kernel 'max' of milestone 1 (largest weighted height) is in effect a point sample at the probe centre: noisy, and with partly unknown maps it creates local minima of the solver's residual (kernel_check.py).
decisions.real images: virtual camera: the real camera turned by the smallest rotation that puts its optical axis through the centre of mass of mask_visib; the depth map is resampled into the stencil square of the stencil camera (nearest pixel) and converted to depth along its axis. Observation 'visib' (no amodal mask): map_fused = the rendering, replaced by the observed depth on mask_visib and by background outside mask_visib where the observed surface lies more than carve_mm behind the rendered object (free space; a nearer surface is an occlusion); fill_visib: pixels of mask_visib without depth count as object (depth of the nearest observed pixel where the rendering misses them) for the centre and the misfit, not for the solver's target (the filled depth is too near at grazing edges). Observation 'mask' (milestone 1): background outside the mask, unknown where occluded or without depth. Pixels outside the image are unknown (edge_cases).
decisions.charts: each chart: a twincher with its stencil (ranges as in 'stencil', overridden by the chart's own 'stencil' entries); all charts and attempts are solved and the solution with the smallest misfit is kept (y-tone difference between rendering and fused map on the known pixels; 'visib': sum divided by the pixels of mask_visib with depth).
decisions.stencil centre: centre c: direction of the model origin; the observation is resampled for the stencil camera aimed at c, so that rendering and observation are aligned, and the pose follows from c. centre: 'com_track' (default: c moved so that the centres of mass of the observed silhouette and of the rendering coincide; centre_silhouette 'fused' or, with the observation 'mask', 'mask'), 'dist_y' (c refined by a quadratic model of |y_fused - y_curr|^2 on a 3 x 3 grid of step centre_h * side of the square; dist_guard: penalty for observed object outside the square; dist_grid 'curr': probes of y_fused at the grid of y_curr), 'com' (stencil camera through the centre of mass, pose by matching the centres of mass).
